_provenance: SUBSTITUTED, not produced by step 4. Derived from G0's six kill-checks and G0.5's items 1-5 by the S1 orchestrator. See audit/HR_PARTIAL_S1/PIPELINE_SUBSTITUTION_MAP.md.

loci.name: Sign and identification of the coherence-competence relationship
loci.one_line: Does enforcing revealed-preference coherence on an agent's choices improve, leave unchanged, or degrade its performance on an outcome that is not itself a preference judgment - and is any published estimate of that sign actually identified?
loci.rationale: The paper's C2. Four published repairs report improvement or no cost; three report degradation across three different axiom systems. The two peer-reviewed ablations most often cited for 'enforcement degrades' are confounded with model capacity and, on length-controlled metrics, point the other way. Nothing published is both isolated and scored on an exogenous outcome.

loci.name: Well-posedness and computability of the minimal-perturbation projection
loci.one_line: Is projecting a choice sequence onto the GARP-consistent set a well-posed, solvable program, or does the non-closedness of that set and the combinatorial ordering search make it heuristic-only?
loci.rationale: The paper's method section stands or falls here. Resolved in G0.5 item 1: a multiplier-free ordinal characterisation gives a single MILP with no bilinearity. Retained as a locus because the residual - non-closedness requiring a strict-preference margin, and open complexity for the perturbation objective - is load-bearing and must be visible in the draft.

loci.name: Whether CCEI can carry a dose axis at all
loci.one_line: Is the Afriat efficiency index reliable enough at the individual-agent level to serve as a graded treatment variable, given that no published ICC estimate for it reaches the conventional 'good' threshold?
loci.rationale: The sharpest attack available on the whole design, and it is in PNAS. Intermethod reliability under presentation change is worse than five-month test-retest - and presentation change is also the lever that produces the headroom the project needs. Headroom and construct validity may be the same variable.

loci.name: Does the object of intervention change the result
loci.one_line: Is repairing an agent's own choice sequence materially different from repairing a judge's rankings, an annotator pool, or a reward head - or is the distinction a framing device?
loci.rationale: This is the entire surviving novelty claim. If a reviewer decides that repairing a judge's pairwise rankings is 'the same thing', the contribution collapses. The strongest defence is not conceptual but methodological: only the own-choices, post-hoc configuration holds capacity and training fixed across doses.

loci.name: Occupancy of the intervention cell
loci.one_line: Is the conjunction - own choices, minimal perturbation, exogenous payoff, dose-response - genuinely unoccupied, or is the apparent gap an artefact of which indexes were searched?
loci.rationale: Two occupants were found only after correcting a broken instrument: one at a non-arXiv conference, one in a central-bank working-paper series wrongly written off as unsearchable. Both residual gaps in the corrected search are metadata-not-full-text, the exact blind spot that hid the first one.

loci.name: Are the cycles a defect or a structure
loci.one_line: When an agent's choices cycle, is that noise to be removed or a genuine multi-objective trade-off whose removal is itself a modelling choice?
loci.rationale: If intransitivity is multi-objective in origin, projecting onto a single acyclic order is scalarisation - which is the losing baseline in the multi-objective preference-tuning literature. This is the one objection the foil paper genuinely raises, and it is answerable only empirically, by splitting cycle sources in the project's own data.
